clarification: At dispatch RVA 0x7bf7f, helper result EAX != 0 branches to 0x7c11c and skips the ordinary interpreter body. EAX == 0 falls through to 0x7bf87 and continues interpreter processing (loop/body at 0x7c08e). Therefore the actor helper returning 0 is not an RPC veto; it permits the script path to continue. Prior statements that the helper does not return true for actor+0xc2>1 describe only the helper result, not denial or suppression of the RPC.
